  As the Configuration Management Officer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and maintaining CM activities across the full project lifecycle. Acting as the primary point of contact for CM-related matters, you will ensure configuration control processes are effectively implemented and maintained while supporting engineering, project, and IT teams.

result.description: Rumdel Construction Pty Ltd  The Construction Supervisor is responsible for the on-site planning, coordination, direction and control of road rehabilitation and pavement construction works, including asphalt milling, in-situ pavement stabilisation, spray sealing and asphalt paving. Operating within Rumdel Construction’s civil delivery teams, the role ensures works are completed safely, on program, within budget and in accordance with contract specifications, Australian Standards and relevant Transport for NSW (TfNSW) and local government requirements.   Benefits  Salary plus 12% super. Company provided vehicle or a vehicle allowance.   Task & responsibilities   Site Planning & Works Coordination   - Plan, organise, direct and coordinate day-to-day road rehabilitation operations across milling, stabilisation, spray seal and asphalt paving activities.   - Interpret engineering drawings, pavement designs and specifications to set out works and confirm levels, depths and tolerances.   - Coordinate labour, plant, materials and subcontractors to maintain continuous, efficient production and meet project milestones.   - Develop and communicate daily work plans, shift schedules and traffic staging arrangements.   Technical & Quality Management   - Supervise asphalt milling to specified depth, profile and cross-fall, ensuring surface preparation meets design requirements.   - Oversee in-situ stabilisation works, including binder spread rates, mixing depth, moisture conditioning and compaction.   - Manage spray sealing operations, including binder and aggregate application rates, temperatures and sequencing.   - Control asphalt paving and compaction to achieve specified thickness, density, joint quality and ride characteristics.   - Verify conformance against Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), TfNSW/MRTS specifications and approved hold and witness points.   Safety, Environment & Compliance   - Implement and enforce WHS requirements, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe systems of work on all activities.   - Manage worksite traffic in accordance with approved Traffic Guidance Schemes and Traffic Management Plans.  - Conduct pre-start meetings, toolbox talks, hazard identification and risk assessments.  - Ensure environmental controls for dust, noise, spillage and water management are maintained.   Plant, Resources & Productivity   - Direct the operation and allocation of milling machines, stabilisers, pavers, rollers, sprayers and support plant.  - Monitor production rates, material usage and wastage to optimise cost and program outcomes.  - Coordinate deliveries of asphalt, aggregates and binders, and liaise with suppliers and the asphalt plant.   Communication, Reporting & Stakeholder Relations   - Maintain accurate site records, daily diaries, quality records and as-built information.  - Liaise with the Project Manager, clients, superintendents, council representatives and the community.  - Provide on-the-job direction, training and mentoring to operators, labourers and apprentices.  - Report progress, productivity, incidents and non-conformances to project management.   Qualification & experience   Skills & Competencies   - Strong practical knowledge of road rehabilitation and pavement construction methods (milling, in-situ stabilisation, spray seal and asphalt paving).  - Ability to interpret civil engineering drawings, pavement designs and technical specifications, including TfNSW and MRTS standards.  - Sound understanding of WHS legislation, traffic management and environmental compliance in civil works.  - Proven ability to plan, coordinate and supervise labour, plant and subcontractors to program.  - Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills.  - Commercial awareness of production rates, materials control and cost management.   Qualifications & Accreditation   - Relevant qualification in Civil Construction or Construction Management, or equivalent demonstrated experience (minimum five years) in civil road construction supervision.  - Demonstrated experience supervising asphalt, in-situ stabilisation and sprayed sealing works.  - General Construction Induction Card (White Card).  - Traffic management accreditation (for example, Prepare a Work Zone Traffic Management Plan) desirable.  - Current driver licence; relevant plant and high-risk work licences desirable.  About Company     At Rumdel Construction, we deliver world-class civil, mining, and road infrastructure solutions with the hands-on expertise forged over decades. Proudly rooted in South Africa and now building across Australia, we combine global standards with local insight.    From remote mining access roads to major arterial highways, our team brings technical excellence, environmental responsibility, and a results-driven mindset to every project.
